name: Legacy Truck Parts
old_description: When your truck is sidelined, every minute counts. Legacy Truck Parts specializes in rapid roadside delivery of premium truck parts in Las Vegas and the surrounding areas. From essential components like brake pads, alternators, and filters to hard-to-find specialty truck parts, our inventory is designed to get you back on the road fast. With our streamlined order process, you can request truck parts online or by phone, and our dedicated team will deliver directly to your location—day or night.
about:
Legacy Truck Parts operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, serving the surrounding region and extending into Kingman, Arizona. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are its founders named in available sources. It began as a parts supplier focused on keeping commercial trucks and trailers operational through rapid parts availability.

The business distributes a broad range of OEM and aftermarket truck and trailer components, covering categories such as air brakes, suspension, cooling, electrical, lighting, and power-train parts. It maintains a physical inventory at its Las Vegas facility and offers roadside delivery directly to disabled vehicles, as well as fleet support services. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are provided.

Customers include independent owner-operators and fleet managers in the trucking, transportation, and logistics sectors. The company's service area spans the Las Vegas metro area and reaches Kingman, Arizona, addressing both emergency breakdowns and scheduled maintenance needs.

Legacy Truck Parts emphasizes competitive pricing, a comprehensive selection from trusted brands, and knowledgeable staff who assist with part identification. Its stated differentiator is the combination of immediate roadside delivery—available day or night—and a commitment to durable, reliable parts that keep trucks on the road.
